title: nymphaea tetragona var. wenzelii
intro: Nymphaea tetragona var. wenzelii, commonly known as the blue lotus or sacred blue lotus, is a plant species belonging to the water lily family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing anxiety and stress, improving sleep quality, and exhibiting anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Nymphaea tetragona var. wenzelii are attributed to its ability to interact with the GABA receptors in the brain, resulting in a calming effect. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include aporphine alkaloids, such as nuciferine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
